description: Header file defining classes and interfaces for camera handling using AVFoundation on iOS/macOS, including camera frame, metadata, delegate classes, and camera control class.

classes.name: CameraFrame
classes.description: Represents a camera frame with pixel data and dimensions.

classes.name: CameraMetadata
classes.description: Holds metadata information from the camera.

classes.name: KivyCaptureDelegate
classes.description: Delegate class for handling video sample buffers.

classes.name: PhotoAppDelegate
classes.description: Handles photo app callbacks, only on iOS.

classes.name: MetadataDelegate
classes.description: Handles metadata output, only on iOS.

classes.name: Camera
classes.description: Main class for camera operations, including capture, frame retrieval, and device control.

methods.name: captureOutput:didOutputSampleBuffer:fromConnection:
methods.description: Delegate method called when a new video sample buffer is available.

methods.name: thisImage:photoAppCallback:usingContextInfo:
methods.description: Callback for processing a captured image, only on iOS.

methods.name: captureOutput:didOutputMetadataObjects:fromConnection:
methods.description: Delegate method for handling metadata output.

methods.name: getOutput
methods.description: Returns the latest camera frame or metadata.

methods.name: haveNewMetadata
methods.description: Checks if new metadata is available.

methods.name: grabFrame
methods.description: Attempts to grab a frame with a timeout.

methods.name: attemptFrameRateSelection
methods.description: Attempts to set a desired frame rate.

methods.name: attemptCapturePreset
methods.description: Attempts to set a capture preset.

methods.name: savePixelsToFile
methods.description: Saves pixel data to a file.
